## Classes and methods

### `LinkElement`

Link element: clicking the element opens a URL.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `wrap(el)` | Wrap an element in a link. |

## Full example

Run it directly in PyCharm, or from the command line: `python malight/elements/link.py`

```python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import os

    from malight import Malight, ColorName

    _out = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),
                                        "..", "..", "output"))
    pen = Malight(os.path.join(_out, "demo_link"), width=660, height=340)
    pen.set_background_color(ColorName.WHITESMOKE)

    pen.text(330, 40, "Link element <a>: clicking it navigates, in a browser",
             font_size=16, h_align="middle", fill_color=ColorName.DIMGRAY)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Wrap any element in a link: a rounded button
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    btn = pen.rect(60, 100, 180, 70, corner_radius=14,
                   fill_color=ColorName.STEELBLUE)
    pen.text(150, 143, "Click me", font_size=22, fill_color="white",
             h_align="middle")
    link = pen.a(btn, "https://www.python.org", tooltip="Open the Python website",
                 description="external link demo")
    print("link href:", link.node.attribs.get("href"))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2) A text link, underlined to look clickable
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    t = pen.text(300, 143, "Read the docs here", font_size=20,
                 fill_color=ColorName.NAVY, underline=True)
    pen.a(t, "https://docs.python.org", tooltip="Python docs")

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3) Image or shape links, and in-page anchors such as "#top"
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    icon = pen.circle(520, 135, 36, fill_color=ColorName.GOLD)
    pen.a(icon, "#top", tooltip="Back to top")

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4) A link element takes filters and opacity too
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    link.set_filter(pen.fx.glow(4, ColorName.SKYBLUE))

    # 5) wrap: create the link, then nest elements (the same as pen.a(el, url))
    holder = pen.a(None, "https://www.example.com", tooltip="demo")
    holder.wrap(pen.text(150, 240, "another link", font_size=20,
                         fill_color=ColorName.TEAL))
    print("second link href:", holder.node.attribs.get("href"))

    # 6) Partial update: change the address or the tooltip
    holder.update(href="https://www.python.org", tooltip="back to the Python website")
    print("href after update:", holder.node.attribs.get("href"))

    pen.finish()
```
